meta.name: troy_horse
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: An unmistakable monumental Trojan horse made from the settlement's own ancient timber palette, using api.theme.wood.planks and api.theme.wood.log with sun-clay stone roles for its small plinth rather than an invented palette. Hollow the body into a concealed walkable chamber with a hidden hatch, room for crouching soldiers and their weapons, and publish a way-in anchor named door; it is the intact gift horse immediately before the soldiers emerge.

A pair of weathered Aegean warship hulks pulled onto the sandy coast beyond Troy's walls, with broken masts, scattered oars, tilted timber hulls and scorched landing traces. Build the ships from api.theme.wood and use the settlement's own ground and stone roles for the wreckage, so the vessels belong to Troy rather than introducing a foreign palette.

tokens.terrain: a walled ancient city on a rise above the sandy Aegean coast, with the sea and beached warships visible beyond the walls
tokens.icons: the Trojan horse before the gates; towering city walls with gates and towers; a citadel-palace above the flat-roofed town; soldiers concealed inside the horse
